## What you should be able to do tonight

- State what width and skew each trade off, and how much your fair value should move on a fill.
- Report your session's profit attribution across the three components.

## Drill <span class='task-total'>interview thread</span>

Spaced repetition, not cramming. Every drill in the year is collected on the [drills page](../drills.qmd).

::: {.task-list .drill}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Timed mixed set, tenth sitting: five problems in fifteen minutes. Score and plot all ten.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> Market making, sixth sitting, with a twist: I trade with you and then tell you I will trade again in the same direction regardless of your quote. What do you do? The answer is not obvious and saying why out loud is the exercise.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> The million dollar question, second attempt. Compare against day 294. A good answer says something about the horizon you would run it over and the drawdown you would accept, both of which you computed on day 129.
:::
:::
